notes:
Real primary-source data (Tier A) from Statistics Finland's triennial Household Budget Survey (Kulutustutkimus), most recent wave = 2022 (survey years 2012, 2016, 2022 only; no 2023/2024 wave exists — 2022 is the latest available). Retrieved via the StatFin PxWeb API (table 14pg for expenditure, table 14qa for disposable income and household counts), NOT scraped from narrative press releases. Figures are annual EUR at current (2022) prices, per household (not per consumption unit) unless noted. Breakdown is by_quintile (I=lowest 20% income to V=highest 20% income), matching Statistics Finland's own income-quintile grouping methodology for this survey (based on disposable income per consumption unit, OECD-modified equivalence scale). 

CATEGORY MAPPING (Finnish COICOP top-level 01-13, ECOICOP 2018 vintage, coded 'coicop_46_20231201' in the API): 04 Housing/water/electricity/gas/fuels -> housing (includes imputed rent for owner-occupiers, COICOP 04.2, which Finland's survey methodology imputes and includes in total consumption expenditure — this differs from BLS/ONS conventions that may treat imputed rent separately; flagged for frontend author). 01 Food/non-alcoholic beverages -> food_at_home in full (Finland's top-level COICOP 01 does not separately break out at-home vs away-from-home dining at this level; away-from-home dining sits under COICOP 11.1, not 01). 11 Restaurants/accommodation services -> food_away (approximation only: also includes hotel/accommodation spending, which is not separable from restaurant/cafe spending at the aggregated level queried; this overstates true food_away and is a documented, not fabricated, approximation). 06 Health -> healthcare_oop (excludes mandatory/voluntary health insurance premiums, which fall under COICOP 12.1.2 Insurance connected with health). 07 Transport -> transport_total in full; transport_work (commute-specific subset) is NOT separately available at the top-level COICOP breakdown queried and is left null rather than estimated. 03 Clothing/footwear -> apparel. 08 Information/communication -> communications. 09 Recreation/sport/culture -> entertainment. 10 Education services -> education (Finland provides largely free public education; this category is expected to be small/near-zero for most households and mainly reflects private tuition, courses, and supplies). 13 Personal care/social protection/misc -> personal_care in full (this category also bundles childcare services under COICOP 13.3.0.1, which cannot be isolated from the top-level aggregate; childcare is therefore left null rather than double-counted or guessed). 02 Alcoholic beverages/tobacco, 05 Furnishings/household equipment, and 12 Insurance/financial services are combined into 'other' (none map cleanly to a dedicated v2 schema category). voluntary_savings is left null: Finland's consumption expenditure survey measures expenditure, not saving/investment flows, so no comparable figure exists in this source. 

avg_income_before_tax is left null for ALL quintiles: table 14qa (background information by income quintile) publishes only 'disposable income per household' (Käytettävissä oleva rahatulo, contentscode Kaytetmk_1_mean), used here as avg_income_after_tax. No gross/pre-tax household income by quintile is published for this specific consumption-survey sample. Finland's separate income distribution survey (StatFin__tjt, e.g. table 128c) does publish gross income by income DECILE, but that is a different sample/survey (register-based income distribution statistics, not the triennial consumption survey) using deciles rather than quintiles — mixing the two would misattribute expenditure and income to different underlying household samples, so it was deliberately NOT done, per the 'do not fabricate' rule for Tier A data. 

housing_owner_share and housing_owner_imputed_rent_estimate are left null for all quintiles: tenure-status-by-income-quintile cross-tabs were not queried/found in a directly joinable StatFin table in the time available (a tenure/building-type table 14lv exists by household type, and 13qk covers heating mode by building type, but neither crosses tenure status with income quintile). Note that COICOP 04.2 imputed rent IS embedded inside the housing figure per Finland's methodology (see above), so imputed rent is not being ignored, only not separately reported as its own line. 

All values in EUR (local currency); frontend applies PPP conversion at display time per project convention. Household counts, average household size, and OECD-modified consumption units per household are available in the raw API response (raw/fi_14qa_response.json) if needed for weighting but were not required by the v2 schema and are omitted from 'rows'.
